subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on financial conditions in Formosa
subfiles.about: An index of Department of State records concerning Taiwan’s budgets, borrowing, banking, exchange controls, and related financial questions from 1930 through 1939.
subfiles.summary: Lists Taihoku reports on Taiwan's 1930-39 budgets, the 1931 $2.8 million Taiwan Electric Power gold-bond issue (Morgan, Kuhn Loeb, Yokohama Specie Bank syndicate), capital-export restrictions, the Specie Bank's China troubles, Dairen customs interference, and a bankers' Taiwan investigation.

interest: Shows routine fiscal surveillance of colonial Taiwan intertwined with Manchurian crisis and exchange-control issues.
